title: Reel It In
introduction: This is a 2-player local multiplayer game where you and a friend mash buttons to reel the biggest fish! This game was developed for a game jam with the constraint: only two buttons allowed.
My main contributions to this project include the fish behavior, reeling mechanic, ending statistics screen, and assets and animation importing.
learned: Our game ended up placing 2nd overall out of around 20 teams, which we were really happy with! Since this was my first 24-hour game jam, I made a conscious effort to keep the scope of the game small, and looking back I'm really glad I did.

Keeping the scope small meant we weren't scrambling to implement features right up until submission, and instead had a good amount of time left over to focus on polishing the game. This included adding a short tutorial to help players understand the mechanics, as well as a small cutscene that helped tie the overall experience together.
